actions.text:
Hello,

I received an email saying I was shortlisted for the Software Engineer L4 role. Before I proceed, could you please confirm this is an official Google recruitment email and provide a link to the job posting on the official Google Careers site (careers.google.com)? The message includes an external link (apply-to-google-jobs.com) and asks to act within 24 hours; I want to verify legitimacy before sharing any personal information or applying.

Thanks,
Jordan Mitchell
(jordan.mitchell@email.com)
